run_camera_tests: run the unittest test suite for pymomentum.camera to verify project and unproject roundtrips
create_camera_with_intrinsics: create a Camera with PinholeIntrinsicsModel and project world points to image coordinates
test_project_unproject_roundtrip: test that projecting then unprojecting 3D points through a Camera recovers the original points
refactor_camera_look_at: refactor the Camera look_at method to position and orient the camera toward a target
review_intrinsics_models: review PinholeIntrinsicsModel, OpenCVIntrinsicsModel, and OpenCVFisheyeIntrinsicsModel for parameter handling and distortion support
